source_findings.finding: The Codex app is framed as a command center for coordinating multiple agents, long-running work, skills, automations, and app/CLI continuity.
source_findings.application: Keep five-lane work under watcher/notifier supervision while Aletheon uses the wait window for research, repair planning, x2 design, and publication prep.

source_findings.finding: The 0.137.0 release lists app-server v2 remote-control RPCs, plugin JSON surfaces, multi-agent v2 metadata improvements, and Windows sandbox setup refresh reliability fixes.
source_findings.application: Favor machine-readable status receipts, direct app-server recovery routes, and wrapper-independent repair gates when a launcher appears stale.

source_findings.finding: Codex emphasizes keeping long-running tasks moving across active threads, approvals, plugins, and project context without staying tied to one manual control surface.
source_findings.application: Use gate-only checks and productive wait work instead of repeatedly polling sibling lanes.

source_findings.finding: Least authority, explicit tool boundaries, and confused-deputy avoidance are core safety principles for tool and connector coordination.
source_findings.application: Keep app lanes, CLI lanes, connector reads, and repo publication separated by phase-scoped receipts and exact mutation boundaries.

source_findings.finding: Logging guidance emphasizes sanitization and avoiding sensitive data in logs and diagnostic records.
source_findings.application: Keep sibling outputs temp-only and publish only hashes, counts, pass/fail statuses, gate labels, and sanitized summaries.

v4_x2_build_implications: Promote the direct app notifier fallback into the standard stale-wrapper decision tree.
Record a dashboard row for wrapper stale, direct route pass, redaction pass, and direct gate pass.
Preserve gate-only sibling checks at the 15 minute x1 mark and avoid interim polling.
Use Codex 0.137.0 app-server and plugin JSON surfaces as design inputs for future machine-readable multiplex status.
Keep CLI long-form evidence status-only: word counts, item counts, hashes, marker review, and no raw response publication.
Keep GMUT, canon, consciousness, and final-physics gates open unless exact closure artifacts prove otherwise.
